source_text: Obviaverunt angeli Dei. Mahanaim — duo castra: Dei et hominis, vel contemplatio et actio.
pass_a_gloss: Met angels of-God. Mahanaim — two camps: of-God and of-human, or contemplation and action.
pass_b_english: [[Angels of God meet him >> Bible:Genesis 32:1]]. [[Mahanaim — two camps >> Bible:Genesis 32:2]]: God’s and man’s, or contemplation and action.
